body_text:
Strong Goldbach conjecture. Every even integer greater than $2$
is the sum of two prime numbers. The order of the two primes is
irrelevant, and equality is allowed; for example, $10=3+7=5+5$.
The conjecture is a universal existence claim, so computation
can verify initial ranges but cannot by itself settle all even
integers.
